mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 255.0 (indicating elevated inflation) triggers a monetary policy tightening response, which increases equity discount rates and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 255.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in labor force participation (PAYEMS) signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening demand for residential construction, which typically precedes a slowdown in overall economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion when HOUST declines, or the Rank IC for the signal in that regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of residential sales (RSAFS > 400,000 million dollars) indicates strong consumer demand and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 400,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE reading above 15.0% (indicating a severe labor market deterioration) signals economic distress and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months when UNRATE exceeds 15.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250.0) indicates persistent inflationary pressures that lead to higher real interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 250.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
